recognize_zh: 低倍視野的血液抹片經 LAP 細胞化學染色，紅血球呈米黃色，散在的小點狀有核細胞染成紫紅或藍色；此倍率只能用來找白血球分布，無法評分。
features: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear with tan-unstained red cells
Scattered nucleated cells with red-counterstained nuclei, some with blue cytoplasmic reaction product
Individual granule intensity cannot be graded at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase (LAP) with a nuclear red counterstain. Leukocytes are evenly distributed across a monolayer of unstained red cells, and several show blue cytoplasmic reaction product. At this magnification the staining intensity of individual neutrophils cannot be graded; scoring requires oil-immersion assessment of 100 consecutive segmented and band neutrophils, each rated 0 to 4+.

ddx.vs: Most neutrophils would lack blue granules at high power, yielding a low total score.

ddx.dx: High LAP score (leukemoid reaction, polycythemia vera, pregnancy, infection)
ddx.vs: Most neutrophils would show 2+ to 4+ granular positivity at high power.
